items: [Multifunctional Wine Bar] This wine cabinet adopts a mesh door design and with a magnetic self-locking device, which realizes the functions of visualization and ventilation. Not only suit for wine lovers, but it can be as coffee bar station, storage cabinet, sofa console table or buffet sideboard. Whether be placed in the living room or dining room and kitchen, it’s chic style blends well with almost all home decor.

items.label: [Multi-Directional Innovation]
items.value: Crafted with sturdy metal frame and durable wood panel, offering an excellent weight capacity of over 360lbs. Adjustable feet on the bottom to prevent wobbling even on uneven floors. The visual mesh door of wine bar makes it easier to access your items and has the benefit of ventilation. The mesh door of the wine cabinet is designed with magnetic suction, which can be easily and perfectly closed with a slight push.

items: [Large Storage Space] The upper portion of the wine cabinet is open storage, the spacious bar top is perfect to showcase coffee makers, cups, plates, fruit trays or even favorite decor. The top left of the wine cooler holds glasses and there is an additional bottle rack in the center for 16 bottles of wine or beer. All-in-one Design combines a wine glass, cup holder, wine rack, and storage shelves, which provides a large capacity to organize wine space. Overall size: 37" D x 11.8" W x 34.6" H.

items.label: [Unique Design]
items.value: Beautiful rustic wood grain, clean lines, and black metal frame flawlessly combined with modern and retro industrial flair. Wine in the center not only aesthetically pleasing but also more convenient to find red wine, both sides of the large space storage can be put wine barrels and different sizes of wine, and can be sorted in the two sides of the space. Furniture style wine rack is perfect for displaying glasses, wine, coffee machines and cups.

items: [Easy to Assemble] This wine cabinet, designed for liquor and glasses, easy to assemble. We provide detailed instructions, complete accessories and gadgets for your quick assembly.
